svg.title: Strategy return sensitivity to transaction costs
svg.desc: Total return at zero, five, ten, and twenty basis points one-way trading cost. SPY buy and hold; TimesFM mini (retrained); TimesFM loop + adapter (retrained); Multiscale residual mixer; Regime linear experts. Identical trading signals are used across cost assumptions.
